schema: FMZ 1003 native session timing and zero-order opening-range replay

model.source: The archive's v2 symbol and timeframe aliases and legacy plot arrow arguments are normalized. The saved v_input_10=true explicitly enables shorts. All source rules and the unguarded opening-range reset are preserved.
model.clock: A 09:30–10:00 session window has no 1h opening bar. The 10:00–11:00 window appears at 10:00 UTC weekdays. At 30m there are exactly 22 valid session starts per market. Weekday session membership and the virtual daily session timestamp are calculated independently.
model.zero_order_proof: The archived reset compares a session timestamp with its immediately previous value using !=. A missing previous value does not trigger the comparison. Within each session the next value remains equal. Therefore neither range becomes available and neither direction orders a trade. Complete native flat marks and empty orders agree on both markets.
model.sensitivity: An explicit missing-value guard detects the 22 session starts. That optional source edit creates 10 BTC and 8 ETH diagnostic order events. Its outcomes are kept outside the saved variant metrics.

coverage: Tested · legacy session range stays undefined · no trades

Complete saved UTC 1h/30m/15m data, restored archived short override and independent weekday clock. No range or trades under the pinned v2 rule. Explicit NA guard changes output and remains diagnostic only.
